summary: Iteration 49: Bulk Product Upload System - Full Testing Complete. All 16 backend tests pass. Frontend UI verified for both Admin and Vendor dashboards. Download Template, Preview, Publish, Sessions, and Revert endpoints all working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Bulk upload system is well-implemented with proper validation
CSV parsing handles all required columns: sku, name, description, price, category
Variant parsing correctly handles Color:Size:Qty format
Session management properly tracks preview/published/reverted states
Both Admin and Vendor can use bulk upload with proper auth checks
seed_data_creation: None - tests create unique SKUs with UUID prefixes
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk upload system is fully functional. Admin can access via Products > Bulk Upload tab. Vendor can access via Products page > Bulk Upload button. Import History shows all sessions with revert capability for published batches.

GET /api/products/bulk/sample-csv.details: Returns CSV template with all required and optional columns

POST /api/products/bulk/preview.details: Parses CSV, validates rows, returns session_id with preview data

POST /api/products/bulk/publish/{session.details: Creates products from valid rows, reports failures

GET /api/products/bulk/sessions.details: Returns list of import sessions for current user (22 admin, 4 vendor)

admin_bulk_upload_tab.details: Products > Bulk Upload tab shows upload form with CSV/ZIP dropzones

admin_download_template.details: Download Template button works, returns proper CSV

admin_import_history.details: Import History tab shows 22 sessions with status and revert buttons

vendor_bulk_upload_button.details: Bulk Upload button visible on vendor Products page

vendor_bulk_upload_form.details: Opens upload form with CSV/ZIP dropzones and column guide

validation_tests.missing_required_fields: PASS - Marks rows as invalid with errors
validation_tests.duplicate_skus: PASS - Detects and reports duplicate SKUs
